phase: Q-SHIFT Stage 4 noise-adaptive hybrid decoder feasibility pilot
scope: Small detector-only identifiability and decoder-rebuild feasibility pilot; not the full Stage 4 experiment

circuit.injection: Independent Stim CORRELATED_ERROR XX at each of five MR boundaries

estimator.name: detector-profile-moment interpolation
inference_inputs: independent calibration batch detector bits only
estimator.features: 40 detector marginal rates plus co-occurrence rates for the five DEM-verified burst detector pairs
estimator.estimation: piecewise-linear interpolation of development profile means; probability selected by minimum diagonal-variance-standardized squared distance on a 0.00001 grid
estimator.confidence_interval: percentile 95% bootstrap interval over rows within the independent calibration batch; diagnostic only

pilot.performance_inference: descriptive feasibility only; no confirmatory significance claim

random_streams.allocation_rule: sequential unique stream IDs listed in seed_inventory.json; no derived or reused offsets

decision_rules.cnn_noise_estimator: do not implement unless the scalar statistical estimator shows identifiability but leaves a demonstrated, decoder-relevant estimation limitation
decision_rules.pilot_interpretation: report probability-estimation error, paired LER differences, decoder disagreements, and runtime; do not select a favorable model based on evaluation labels

resources.device_policy: CPU Stim/PyMatching feasibility pilot; no neural training
